stories.headline: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
stories.description: Several French cities banned protests, and President Macron said only union demos are allowed.

stories.headline: How Sudan’s shift to drone warfare is fuelling a civilian crisis
stories.description: Drone attacks on supply lines and safe cities are taking a devastating toll on civilians.
